sections.kicker: Prepared for Nest 19 by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Nest 19 lists its menu. Its visitors are the ones naming the diner.
sections.keep: The vinyl and framed art wall. Nothing else on the grid is as specific to Nest 19.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The bio lists the menu, like every burger place in Dubai.
pins.why: A reviewer on your grid says Dubai has no shortage of burger spots. The diner idea lives in visitors' words, not in your bio.
pins.how: Name the diner in the first line and let the menu follow.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: A diner with a point of view looks like one more burger counter.

pins.area: Yellow and black repost tile among the orange tiles
pins.what: Reposts bring a second type style into your own grid.
pins.why: Your condensed orange type and bubble logo are distinct. The repost tiles speak in a different voice.
pins.how: Keep reposts in stories and let the grid stay your own type.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The grid looks borrowed in places.

pins.quote: who else is obsessed with our new wall art?
pins.what: The vinyl shelf is the most specific thing in the feed, shown once.
pins.why: Records, frames and a pink vinyl say a 90s diner better than the word diner.
pins.how: Make the wall a recurring backdrop for the food.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: Your most distinct room appears as a single post.
